title: Humble Beginnings
intro: The sun rises over the Caribbean, painting the waves gold...
You stand at the helm of your newly stolen sloop, the 'Sea Rat'.
The previous owner lies tied up below deck - he won't be needing his ship anymore.
Word has reached you of a small merchant convoy passing through these waters.
Three fat merchant ships, ripe for the taking.
Their holds are filled with Spanish gold, and their guns are few.
This is your chance. Prove yourself worthy of the pirate's life!
Your crew awaits your orders, Captain...
victory: The merchant ships burn and sink, their precious cargo now yours!
Your crew cheers as they count the plundered gold: 800 pieces!
The survivors flee in a lifeboat, carrying tales of your ferocity.
You've taken your first step toward legend.
But this is only the beginning...
Greater prizes await those brave - or foolish - enough to pursue them.
defeat: The Sea Rat sinks beneath the waves, your dreams sinking with it...
The merchant guards were more prepared than you thought.
Their cannons found their mark, and your crew abandons ship.
You cling to floating wreckage, watching your ship disappear.
Perhaps the pirate's life is not for you after all...
